Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Freight is looking for a senior backend engineer to own our telemetry ingest pipeline.

What you will do:
- Own ingest, storage and replay for telemetry from several thousand trucks
- Work directly with the dispatch team on what the data needs to answer

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production services in Node.js or a comparable runtime
- Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design under load
- Experience mentoring junior engineers through code review

Bonus points for:
- Familiarity with the logistics or freight domain
- Exposure to event sourcing

Data Engineer

Northwind Analytics turns retail point-of-sale data into demand forecasts for regional grocery chains.

You will need:
- 3+ years with Python and SQL in a production data environment
- Experience building and monitoring scheduled data pipelines
- Comfort talking directly to non-technical stakeholders about forecast accuracy

Nice to have:
- Retail or supply chain experience
Engineer wanted. Must be good with computers and available soon.

Frontend Engineer

We are hiring a frontend engineer to rebuild our operations console.

Required:
- 4+ years with React and TypeScript
- Experience with accessibility beyond an audit checklist

Preferred:
- Design systems experience

Staff Platform Engineer

You will own the deployment platform used by every team here.

We are looking for:
- 8+ years in infrastructure, at least 3 of them on Kubernetes in production
- Demonstrated ownership of an on-call rotation and its incident review process
- Ability to influence engineering practice across teams without direct authority

Bonus:
- Go
- Experience running a multi-region control plane
